results.name: Resistance Band Standing Hip Abduction
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a loop resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees. Bend your hips and knees to lower into a half-squat position, and lean your back slightly forward, keeping your back straight.
Press your knees outward against the band's resistance, opening your legs as wide as possible.
Slowly bring your knees back together to the starting position with control, keeping tension in the band.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining the half squat position.
tips: Exhale as you press your knees outward and inhale as you bring them back together.
Use a resistance band that provides enough tension to challenge your muscles without compromising form.
Ensure your feet remain flat on the floor and your weight is evenly distributed.
results.description: Resistance Band Standing Hip Abduction is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abductors (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Quadriceps.

results.name: Seated Hip Abductor Machine
instructions: Sit down on the hip abduction machine and place your feet flat on the footrests while positioning your outer thighs against the padded levers.
Grip the side handles to stabilize your upper body and press your legs outward against the resistance, pushing the pads apart in a controlled motion.
Pause for a second at the peak of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Sit upright with your back firmly against the backrest to maintain proper posture.
Focus on squeezing your glutes and outer thighs throughout the movement.
Perform the movement slowly and avoid using momentum to push the legs outward.
results.description: Seated Hip Abductor Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abductors, Core.

results.name: Seated Leg Extension Single Leg
instructions: Sit on the leg extension machine. Position both feet under the padded lever, with the lever resting just above your ankles.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for support. Engage your core and keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest.
Extend your right leg by pushing the padded lever upward, straightening your knee, then slowly lower the lever to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement to reduce strain on your joints.
Keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest to maintain proper form.
Exhale as you extend your legs and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Seated Leg Extension Single Leg is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Seated Leg Extension Alternate Legs
instructions: Sit on the leg extension machine. Position both feet under the padded lever, with the lever resting just above your ankles.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for support. Engage your core and keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest.
Extend your right leg by pushing the padded lever upward, straightening your knee, then slowly lower the lever to the starting position.
Immediately repeat the movement with your left leg. Alternate between right and left legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement to reduce strain on your joints.
Keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest to maintain proper form.
Exhale as you extend your legs and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Seated Leg Extension Alternate Legs is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Seated Leg Extension Both Legs
instructions: Sit on the leg extension machine. Position your feet under the padded lever, with the lever resting just above your ankles.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for support. Engage your core and keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest.
Extend your legs by pushing the padded lever upward, straightening your knees, then slowly lower the lever to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement to reduce strain on your joints.
Keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest to maintain proper form.
Exhale as you extend your legs and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Seated Leg Extension Both Legs is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Seated Machine Hip Adductor
instructions: Sit on a hip abductor machine with your back straight, knees open wide and bent, and feet on the footrests.
Set the padded bars against the inner sides of your knees.
Close your knees to bring the bars together.
As the bars come together, return to the initial position and repeat.
results.description: Seated Machine Hip Adductor is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Sissy Squat Bodyweight
instructions: Stand tall holding a support for balance, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto your toes and lean your torso back as you bend your knees forward.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your quadriceps, keeping hips and torso in a straight line.
Push through the balls of your feet to return to the start.
tips: Advanced for the knees; go only as low as is comfortable.
Keep your hips extended, not bent.
results.description: Sissy Squat Bodyweight is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Core.

results.name: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Heels Elevated Squats
instructions: Place a small plate or wedge under your heels and step under the Smith bar with your feet close together.
Unrack the bar with it resting on your upper back.
Squat down, letting your knees travel forward, until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive back up and repeat.
tips: The raised heels put the focus on the quadriceps.
Keep your torso upright.
results.description: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Heels Elevated Squats is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Standing Cable Hip Flexion
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and fasten it to one ankle, facing away from the machine.
Hold a support and stand tall.
Drive your knee forward and up to hip height against the cable.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your torso still.
Don't lean back to lift the knee.
results.description: Standing Cable Hip Flexion is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Abdominals.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hip Bridge
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about knee height. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, placing your heels in the handles.
Engage your core and press your heels into the handles, lifting your hips towards the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, ensuring your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them back down.
Focus on using your glutes and hamstrings to lift your hips, avoiding excessive use of your lower back.
Use a mat to provide cushioning and support for your back.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Hip Bridge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back, Core.
